summary: Quiet residential kerb at a bend, homes close on both sides.

best_section.where: north kerb on the bend, beside the large grey-roofed house's frontage

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 6-12 m on the same side, more across the road within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed street; no cars parked in imagery, so room at the kerb is unproven.
drivers.convention: Signs: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; no sign of overnight camping.

flags: Signed 2P parking with resident permits excepted
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy, mostly open on the road; shade from trees to the south.
